Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixingthe Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density
